reauth_confirm.title: Update LAN check code
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current LAN check code shown on your printer.

user.title: Connect to your Creator 5
user.description: Enable LAN mode, then enter the printer IP and LAN code. Setup checks only that address and identifies the model automatically. Creator 5 Pro is live-tested; base Creator 5 support is unverified.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read printer status. Check address, firmware and network access.
error.invalid_auth: Check serial number, LAN check code and LAN mode.
error.invalid_config: Enter a private IPv4 address and a nonempty LAN code.
error.discovery_failed: Could not identify the printer at that address. Check its IP, LAN mode and access to UDP port 48899. No other addresses were searched.
error.unsupported_model: This device is not a supported Creator 5 or Creator 5 Pro.
error.model_mismatch: Discovery and authenticated status did not identify the same Creator 5 model. Setup was not saved.

init.title: Monitoring, materials and optional controls
init.description: Open [Creator 5 tools]({setup_url}) for files, dashboards and alerts. The tools sidebar shortcut and file actions are off by default. Each upload, start or cancellation requires confirmation. Saving options sends no printer command. Existing tool assignments are manual.

data.camera_stream_url: Camera MJPEG URL (optional; otherwise use printer report)
data.job_controls: Enable pause, resume and completion acknowledgement
data.material_controls: Enable slot material and color editing (idle only)
data.printer_controls: Enable speed override and auto shutdown settings
data.show_setup_sidebar: Show Creator 5 tools in the sidebar
data.file_controls: Enable file uploads, reprints and cancellation (admin confirmation required)

error.invalid_options: Check the update interval, camera address, tool assignments, cooling threshold, alert delays and maintenance intervals.
